verses.translation: For the end. Destroy not: by David, for a memorial.

translations.ron: De grăiţi într-adevăr dreptate, drept judecaţi, fii ai oamenilor.
translations.grk: Εἰς τὸ τέλος, μὴ διαφθείρῃς, τῷ Δαυὶδ εἰς στηλογραφίαν.

verses.translation: If ye do indeed speak righteousness, then do ye judge rightly, ye sons of men.

translations.ron: Pentru că în inimă fărădelege lucraţi pe pământ, nedreptate mâinile voastre împletesc.
translations.grk: Εἰ ἀληθῶς ἄρα δικαιοσύνην λαλεῖτε, εὐθεῖα κρίνετε οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

verses.translation: For ye work iniquities in your hearts in the earth: your hands plot unrighteousness.

translations.ron: Înstrăinatu-s-au păcătoşii de la naştere, rătăcit-au din pântece, grăit-au minciuni.
translations.grk: Καὶ γὰρ ἐν καρδίᾳ ἀνομίας ἐργάζεσθε ἐν τῇ γῇ, ἀδικίαν αἱ χεῖρες ὑμῶν συμπλέκουσιν.

verses.translation: Sinners have gone astray from the womb: they go astray from the belly: they speak lies.

translations.ron: Mânia lor după asemănarea şarpelui, ca a unei vipere surde, care-şi astupă urechile ei,
translations.grk: Ἀπηλλοτριώθησαν οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἀπὸ μήτρας, ἐπλανήθησαν ἀπὸ γαστρὸς, ἐλάλησαν ψευδῆ.

verses.translation: Their venom is like that of a serpent; as that of a deaf asp, and that stops her ears;

translations.ron: Care nu va auzi glasul descântătoarelor, al vrăjitorului care vrăjeşte cu iscusinţă.
translations.grk: Θυμὸς αὐτοῖς κατὰ τὴν ὁμοίωσιν τοῦ ὄφεως, ὡσεὶ ἀσπίδος κωφῆς, καὶ βυούσης τὰ ὦτα αὐτῆς,

verses.translation: which will not hear the voice of charmers, nor heed the charm prepared skilfully by the wise.

translations.ron: Dumnezeu va zdrobi dinţii lor în gura lor; măselele leilor le-a sfărâmat Domnul.
translations.grk: ἥτις οὐκ εἰσακούσεται φωνὴν ἐπᾳδόντων, φαρμάκου τε φαρμακευομένου παρὰ σοφοῦ.

verses.translation: God has crushed their teeth in their mouth: God has broken the cheek-teeth of the lions.

translations.ron: De nimic se vor face, ca apa care trece; întinde-va arcul Său până ce vor slăbi.
translations.grk: Ὁ Θεὸς συνέτριψε τοὺς ὀδόντας αὐτῶν ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν, τὰς μύλας τῶν λεόντων συνέθλασεν ὁ Κύριος.

verses.translation: They shall utterly pass away like water running through: he shall bend his bow till they shall fail.

translations.ron: Ca ceara ce se topeşte vor fi nimiciţi; a căzut foc peste ei şi n-au văzut soarele.
translations.grk: Ἐξουδενωθήσονται ὡς ὕδωρ διαπορευόμενον, ἐντενεῖ τὸ τόξον αὐτοῦ ἕως οὗ ἀσθενήσουσιν.

verses.translation: They shall be destroyed as melted wax: the fire has fallen and they have not seen the sun.

translations.ron: Înainte ca spinii voştri să se aprindă, ca pe nişte vii întru mânie îi va înghiţi pe ei.
translations.grk: Ὡσεὶ κηρὸς ὁ τακεῖς ἀνταναιρεθήσονται, ἔπεσε πῦρ, καὶ οὐκ εἶδον τὸν ἥλιον.

verses.translation: Before your thorns feel the white thorn, he shall swallow you up as living, as in his wrath.

translations.ron: Veseli-se-va dreptul când va vedea răzbunarea împotriva necredincioşilor; mâinile lui le va spăla în sângele păcătosului.
translations.grk: Πρὸ τοῦ συνιέναι τὰς ἀκάνθας ὑμῶν τὴν ῥάμνον, ὡσεὶ ζῶντας ὡσεὶ ἐν ὀργῇ καταπίεται ὑμᾶς.

verses.translation: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance of the ungodly: he shall wash his hands in the blood of the sinner.

translations.ron: Şi va zice omul: "Da, este răsplată pentru cel drept! Da, este Dumnezeu Care îi judecă pe ei în viată!
translations.grk: Εὐφρανθήσεται δίκαιος, ὅταν ἴδῃ ἐκδίκησιν ἀσεβῶν, τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ νίψεται ἐν τῷ αἵματι τοῦ ἁμαρτωλοῦ.

verses.translation: And a man shall say, Verily then there is a reward for the righteous: verily there is a God that judges them in the earth.

translations.grk: Καὶ ἐρεῖ ἄνθρωπος, εἰ ἄρα ἐστὶ καρπὸς τῷ δικαίῳ, ἄρα ἐστὶν ὁ Θεὸς κρίνων αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ γῇ.
